config_change_vs_baseline.name: ball_context (v9b)
config_change_vs_baseline.what: Inject per-frame ball coordinates from v9b YOLO into the 32B classification prompt. Each frame's timestamp label gets a `[ball@(x,y):conf;...]` suffix; a prompt prefix explains the format and tells 32B to treat detections as hints to verify visually.

v9b_first_in_game_evidence.win_idx_50_sample: stats: 73/255 frames had ball detections (~29% rate)
v9b_first_in_game_evidence.per_frame_overhead: 0.54s for 5 frames via MPS on Mac

targets.hypothesis: 32B has the visual but cannot perceive the 3-5 px ball on new venue. Giving it explicit coordinates should unlock goal/shot classification.
targets.success_criteria: agg F1 > 0.40 OR new-venue goal recall > 4/16
targets.neutral: agg F1 ~0.32 with same goal recall — 32B ignores the annotations
targets.regression: agg F1 < 0.30 — annotations confuse 32B (e.g., it over-fires shot_on_target on every ball detection)

notes: Run #79: first test of upstream-signal injection. v9b annotations only — no derived trajectory features yet. If MVP shows signal, Phase 2 adds velocity / zone-entry features.
